description: Source code for a registry handling module in a graphics API code generation tool, including classes for registry features, types, commands, and an API registry loader and generator.

classes.name: BaseInfo
classes.description: Base class for registry feature information, tracking required and declared states.

classes.name: TypeInfo
classes.description: Registry information about a type, inherits from BaseInfo.

classes.name: GroupInfo
classes.description: Registry information about a group of enums, inherits from BaseInfo.

classes.name: EnumInfo
classes.description: Registry information about an enum, inherits from BaseInfo, includes type attribute.

classes.name: CmdInfo
classes.description: Registry information about a command, inherits from BaseInfo, includes GLX protocol info.

classes.name: FeatureInfo
classes.description: Registry information about an API feature or extension, inherits from BaseInfo, includes name, category, number, emit.

classes.name: GeneratorOptions
classes.description: Base class for options used during header generation, includes regex patterns and versioning info.

classes.name: CGeneratorOptions
classes.description: Subclass of GeneratorOptions with additional C-specific header generation options.

classes.name: OutputGenerator
classes.description: Base class for generating API interface code, manages logging and output file handling.

classes.name: COutputGenerator
classes.description: Subclass of OutputGenerator for generating C language headers, includes methods for generating C declarations.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Represents an API registry loaded from XML, manages types, commands, features, and generates API headers.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Utility function to write arguments to a file or stdout with an optional end string.

methods.name: matchAPIProfile
methods.description: Checks if an element's 'api' and 'profile' attributes match requested API and profile strings.

methods.name: BaseInfo.resetState
methods.description: Resets required and declared flags to initial state.

methods.name: TypeInfo.__init__
methods.description: Initializes TypeInfo with an XML element.

methods.name: GroupInfo.__init__
methods.description: Initializes GroupInfo with an XML element, including enums dictionary.

methods.name: EnumInfo.__init__
methods.description: Initializes EnumInfo with an XML element, including type attribute.

methods.name: CmdInfo.__init__
methods.description: Initializes CmdInfo with an XML element, including GLX protocol info.

methods.name: FeatureInfo.__init__
methods.description: Initializes FeatureInfo with an XML element, setting name, category, number, emit.

methods.name: regSortCategoryKey
methods.description: Sort key for features by category: core, extensions, others.

methods.name: regSortNameKey
methods.description: Sort key for features by name.

methods.name: regSortNumberKey
methods.description: Sort key for features by version number.

methods.name: regSortFeatures
methods.description: Sorts a list of features by category, name, then version.

methods.name: GeneratorOptions.__init__
methods.description: Initializes options with regex patterns and version info.

methods.name: CGeneratorOptions.__init__
methods.description: Initializes C-specific header generation options.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.__init__
methods.description: Initializes output generator with log files.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.logMsg
methods.description: Logs messages at different levels: error, warn, diag.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.beginFile
methods.description: Starts a new output file with given generation options.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.endFile
methods.description: Closes output file and flushes logs.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.beginFeature
methods.description: Starts generating a feature section.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.endFeature
methods.description: Ends feature section.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.genType
methods.description: Generates code for a type; raises warning if not in feature.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.genEnum
methods.description: Generates code for an enum; raises warning if not in feature.

methods.name: OutputGenerator.genCmd
methods.description: Generates code for a command; raises warning if not in feature.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.makeCDecls
methods.description: Creates C function pointer typedefs for a command element.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.newline
methods.description: Writes a newline to the output file.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.beginFile
methods.description: Starts C header file with include guards and C++ extern.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.endFile
methods.description: Ends C header file, closing guards and extern.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.beginFeature
methods.description: Prepares to generate a feature section.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.endFeature
methods.description: Outputs the feature section including types, enums, commands.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.genType
methods.description: Generates C code for a type, replacing <apientry> tags.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.genEnum
methods.description: Generates C code for an enum as a #define.

methods.name: COutputGenerator.genCmd
methods.description: Generates C code for a command, including prototypes.

methods.name: Registry.loadElementTree
methods.description: Loads an ElementTree into the registry and parses it.

methods.name: Registry.loadFile
methods.description: Loads an XML file into the registry.

methods.name: Registry.setGenerator
methods.description: Sets the output generator object.

methods.name: Registry.parseTree
methods.description: Parses the XML tree to populate internal dictionaries.

methods.name: Registry.dumpReg
methods.description: Outputs internal dictionaries for debugging.

methods.name: Registry.addElementInfo
methods.description: Adds an element's info to the appropriate dictionary.

methods.name: Registry.lookupElementInfo
methods.description: Looks up an element's info by name, considering API qualification.

methods.name: Registry.parseTree
methods.description: Parses the registry XML, populating types, enums, commands, features, extensions.

methods.name: Registry.markTypeRequired
methods.description: Marks a type as required, including dependencies.

methods.name: Registry.markRequired
methods.description: Marks features, enums, commands as required or not.

methods.name: Registry.requireAndRemoveFeatures
methods.description: Processes <require> and <remove> tags for features.

methods.name: Registry.generateFeature
methods.description: Generates code for a feature and its dependencies.

methods.name: Registry.generateRequiredInterface
methods.description: Generates code for all features required by a version/extension.

methods.name: Registry.apiGen
methods.description: Generates API headers for specified API version and profile.

methods.name: Registry.apiReset
methods.description: Resets internal feature state flags.

methods.name: Registry.validateGroups
methods.description: Validates group attributes in commands and parameters.
